// Look-ahead radar (Grafana Canvas). Reads only the risk register MiniBankLookahead(); one row of fields for the fixed spots.
let dn = dynamic(['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']);
let mn = dynamic(['','Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']);
let nowW = now() + 7h;
let fd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dn[toint(dayofweek(t) / 1d)]), ' ', tostring(dayofmonth(t)), ' ', tostring(mn[getmonth(t)]), iff(getyear(t) != getyear(nowW), strcat(' ', tostring(getyear(t))), '')) };
let slots = datatable(Slot: string, Key: string) [ 'C0a', 'C01', 'C0b', 'C02', 'C1a', 'C11', 'C1b', 'C12', 'C2a', 'C21', 'C2b', 'C22', 'C3a', 'C31', 'C4a', 'C41', 'D0a', 'D01', 'D1a', 'D11', 'D2a', 'D21', 'D3a', 'D31', 'D4a', 'D41', 'K0a', 'K01', 'K1a', 'K11', 'K1b', 'K12', 'K2a', 'K21', 'K3a', 'K31', 'K3b', 'K32', 'K4a', 'K41', 'L0a', 'L01', 'L1a', 'L11', 'L2a', 'L21', 'L3a', 'L31', 'L4a', 'L41', 'S0a', 'S01', 'S1a', 'S11', 'S2a', 'S21', 'S3a', 'S31', 'S4a', 'S41' ];
let titles = datatable(Sector: string, Title: string, Nice: string, Ord: int) [ 'K', 'KEYS AND CERTIFICATES', 'Keys and certificates', 1, 'C', 'CAPACITY', 'Capacity', 2, 'L', 'LICENCES', 'Licences', 3, 'D', 'DATA', 'Data', 4, 'S', 'SERVICE BUDGET', 'Service budget', 5 ];
let reg = materialize(MiniBankLookahead()
| extend W = todouble(extract(@'warning is reached in ([0-9.]+) days', 1, Basis)),
         WarnTxt = replace_string(extract(@'warning ([0-9.]+ [a-zA-Z%]+)', 1, Limit), '.0 ', ' '),
         DueW = todatetime(extract(@'due ([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})', 1, Limit)),
         WarnD = todatetime(extract(@'warning is reached in [0-9.]+ days \(([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\)', 1, Basis)),
         LimD = todatetime(extract(@'limit in [0-9.]+ days \(([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\)', 1, Basis))
| extend Dx = iff(isnotnull(DueW), (DueW - nowW) / 1d, todouble(DaysLeft))
| extend D = iff(isnotnull(W), W, Dx)
| extend Sector = case(Lens == 'Service', 'S', Lens == 'Capacity', 'C',
        Lens == 'Calendar' and (Item has 'token' or Item startswith 'Password' or Item has 'certificate'), 'K',
        Lens == 'Calendar' and (Item has 'evaluation' or Item has 'licen'), 'L',
        Lens == 'Calendar', 'D', Lens == 'Posture', 'P', 'X')
| extend Trend = Lens in ('Capacity', 'Service'),
         Code = case(Status == 'Act', 1, Status == 'Watch', 2, Status == 'Planned', 3, Status == 'OK', 4, 5),
         Lim = replace_regex(replace_regex(Limit, @'\.0 ', ' '), @' \(warning.*$', '')
| extend Lapsed = Status == 'Planned' and isnotnull(DueW) and DueW <= nowW
| extend Core = (Sector == 'P' and Status in ('Act', 'Watch')) or Lapsed
| extend Name = case(Item has 'push token', 'Image push token lapses', Item has 'pull token', 'Image pull token expires',
        Item startswith 'Password expires', 'Oracle password', Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows evaluation',
        Item has 'certificate', 'Ingress certificate', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'Oldest data ages out',
        Item == 'Node disk used', strcat(Resource, ' disk ', Lim), Item == 'Memory used, busiest pod', 'Transfer pod memory',
        Item == 'Data into Log Analytics per day', 'Log Analytics daily cap', Item startswith 'Business transactions P95', 'Payments P95 (speed)',
        substring(strcat(Resource, ' ', Item), 0, 26)),
         What = case(Item == 'Node disk used', strcat(Resource, ' disk reaches ', Lim), Item == 'Memory used, busiest pod', strcat('Transfer pod memory reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Data into Log Analytics per day', strcat('Log Analytics reaches its ', Lim, ' daily cap'),
        Item startswith 'Business transactions P95', strcat('Payments P95 reach the ', WarnTxt, ' warning'),
        Item startswith 'Oldest', 'Oldest lab data starts to age out', Item has 'push token', 'Image push token lapses', Item has 'pull token', 'Image pull token expires',
        Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows evaluation ends',
        Item startswith 'Password expires', 'Oracle password expires', Item has 'certificate', 'Ingress certificate expires',
        substring(strcat(Resource, ': ', Item), 0, 40)));
let con = materialize(reg
| where not(Core) and Sector in ('K', 'C', 'L', 'D', 'S') and isnotnull(D) and D <= 730
| extend T = iff(isnotnull(DueW), DueW, iff(isnotnull(WarnD), WarnD, nowW + 1d * D))
| summarize N = count(), D = min(D), T = min(T), W = min(W), DaysLeft = min(DaysLeft), LimD = min(LimD), Status = take_any(Status), Owner = take_any(Owner),
            What = take_any(What), WarnTxt = take_any(WarnTxt), Lim = take_any(Lim) by Sector, Name, Code, Trend, Day = startofday(T)
| extend Name = iff(N > 1, strcat(iff(Name == 'Oracle password', 'Oracle passwords', Name), ' (', N, ')'), Name),
         What = iff(N > 1, strcat(replace_string(What, 'password expires', 'passwords expire'), ' (', N, ')'), What)
| extend Band = case(D <= 7, 0, D <= 30, 1, D <= 90, 2, D <= 180, 3, 4), Today = startofday(T) == startofday(nowW)
| extend DLine = case(Status == 'Planned', strcat(iff(Today, 'Today', fd(T)), ' ', format_datetime(T, 'HH:mm'), ' · by design'),
                      isnotnull(W), strcat('~', fd(T), ' · hits ', WarnTxt),
                      Trend, strcat('~', fd(T), ' · trend'),
                      strcat(fd(T), iff(D < 30, strcat(' ', format_datetime(T, 'HH:mm')), ''), ' · ', tostring(toint(round(D, 0))), ' d')));
let ranked = con | order by Sector asc, Band asc, D asc | extend Idx = row_number(1, prev(Sector) != Sector or prev(Band) != Band) | extend Key = strcat(Sector, tostring(Band), tostring(Idx));
let more = ranked | join kind=leftanti (slots) on Key | summarize More = count() by Sector;
let A = toscalar(ranked | join kind=inner (slots) on Key
  | extend F = iff(Trend, 6, Code), B = iff(Trend, Code, 7)
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat(Slot, '_n'), Name, strcat(Slot, '_d'), DLine, strcat(Slot, '_f'), tostring(F), strcat(Slot, '_b'), tostring(B), strcat(Slot, '_c'), tostring(Code), strcat(Slot, '_h'), tostring(Code + 10))
  | summarize make_bag(P));
let K5 = toscalar(con | top 5 by D asc | serialize I = row_number()
  | extend Wh = case(Status == 'Planned', strcat(iff(Today, 'Today', fd(T)), ' ', format_datetime(T, 'HH:mm')), Trend, strcat('~', fd(T)),
                     strcat(fd(T), iff(D < 30, strcat(' ', format_datetime(T, 'HH:mm')), ''))),
           Sb = case(Status == 'Planned', 'left to lapse by design', isnotnull(W), strcat('trend · ', Owner, ' · limit ', Lim, ' ~', fd(iff(isnotnull(LimD), LimD, nowW + 1d * DaysLeft))),
                     Trend, strcat('trend · ', Owner), strcat('known date · ', Owner)),
           Dx = strcat(iff(D < 10, tostring(round(D, 1)), tostring(toint(round(D, 0)))), ' d')
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('k', I, '_w'), Wh, strcat('k', I, '_n'), What, strcat('k', I, '_s'), Sb, strcat('k', I, '_x'), Dx, strcat('k', I, '_c'), tostring(Code), strcat('k', I, '_g'), '8')
  | summarize make_bag(P));
let CR = toscalar(reg | where Core
  | extend Lc = replace_regex(replace_string(replace_string(Limit, 'at most ', ''), '1.0 days', '1 day'), @'\.0 ', ' '), Nw = replace_regex(Now, @'\.0 ', ' ')
  | extend Txt = case(Lapsed, strcat(replace_string(Name, ' lapses', ''), ' lapsed ', fd(DueW), ' ', format_datetime(DueW, 'HH:mm'), ' (by design)'),
                      Item has 'backup', strcat(replace_string(Resource, 'SQL Server ', 'SQL '), ' full backup: ', Nw, ' old (limit ', Lc, ')'),
                      Item has 'Windows update', strcat('Windows updates: ', Nw, ' old (limit ', Lc, ')'),
                      substring(strcat(Resource, ': ', Item, ' ', Nw, ' (limit ', Lc, ')'), 0, 70))
  | summarize Res = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(make_set(Resource)), ', '), Code = min(Code) by Txt
  | extend Txt = iff(Txt startswith 'Windows updates', strcat(Res, ' ', Txt), Txt)
  | order by Code asc, Txt asc | take 4 | serialize I = row_number()
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('c', I, '_t'), Txt, strcat('c', I, '_c'), tostring(Code))
  | summarize make_bag(P));
let Q = toscalar(titles | join kind=leftanti (con | where D <= 30 | distinct Sector) on Sector | order by Ord asc | summarize strcat_array(make_list(Nice), ', '));
let M = toscalar(titles | join kind=leftouter (more) on Sector
  | extend P = bag_pack(strcat('s', Sector, '_t'), strcat(Title, iff(coalesce(More, 0) > 0, strcat('  +', tostring(More), ' more'), ''))) | summarize make_bag(P));
print b = bag_merge(A, K5, CR, M, bag_pack('now_d', strcat(tostring(dayofmonth(nowW)), ' ', tostring(mn[getmonth(nowW)])),
                                         'q_t', iff(isempty(Q), '', strcat('QUIET (nothing within 30 days): ', Q)),
                                         'ft1', strcat('Read ', format_datetime(nowW, 'HH:mm'), ' WIB from the risk register; refreshes every 15 minutes.')),

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Look-ahead trail (Grafana Canvas) on the board MiniBank - Look-ahead: one row of fields for the fixed spots of the panel.
// READ-ONLY: reads only the Look-ahead risk register MiniBankLookahead() (the same function as the radar, tiles and register table).
// The board setting 'Look ahead to' (variable ff: 0, 7, 14, 30 days or a date yyyy-mm-dd) moves the date; nothing else changes.
// Known dates stay exact; capacity and speed dates come from the same straight-line trends; guard: only dates within 2 years.
let dn = dynamic(['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']);
let mn = dynamic(['','Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']);
let nowW = now() + 7h;
let ffs = trim(@'\s+', tostring(${ff:singlequote}));
let ffn = todouble(ffs);
let ffd = todatetime(ffs);
let A0 = case(isnotnull(ffn), nowW + 1d * max_of(0.0, min_of(ffn, 730.0)), isnotnull(ffd), ffd + 12h, nowW);
let A = max_of(nowW, min_of(A0, nowW + 730d));
let FF = A > nowW + 1h;
let fdd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dayofmonth(t)), ' ', tostring(mn[getmonth(t)]), iff(getyear(t) != getyear(nowW), strcat(' ', tostring(getyear(t))), '')) };
let fd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dn[toint(dayofweek(t) / 1d)]), ' ', fdd(t)) };
let th = (n: long) { iff(n >= 1000, strcat(tostring(n / 1000), ',', substring(tostring(1000 + n % 1000), 1)), tostring(n)) };
let nf = (x: real) { iff(x >= 100.0, th(tolong(round(x, 0))), tostring(round(x, 1))) };
let reg = materialize(MiniBankLookahead()
| extend DueW = todatetime(extract(@'due ([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})', 1, Limit)),
         Wd = todouble(extract(@'warning is reached in ([0-9.]+) days', 1, Basis)),
         AboveW = Basis has 'already above the' and Basis has 'warning',
         WarnTxt = replace_string(extract(@'warning ([0-9.]+ [a-zA-Z%]+)', 1, Limit), '.0 ', ' '),
         Lim = replace_regex(replace_regex(Limit, @'\.0 ', ' '), @' \(warning.*$', ''),
         DL = todouble(DaysLeft),
         NowV = todouble(extract(@'^(-?[0-9.]+)', 1, Now)));
let ev = reg
| extend Kinds = case(isnotnull(DueW), dynamic(['due']),
                      Item startswith 'Business transactions P95', dynamic(['warn', 'limit']),
                      Lens in ('Capacity', 'Service') and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 730.0, dynamic(['limit']),
                      Lens == 'Posture' and Status in ('Act', 'Watch'), dynamic(['carry']),
                      dynamic([]))
| mv-expand K = Kinds to typeof(string)
| extend T = case(K == 'due', DueW,
                  K == 'warn' and AboveW, nowW - 1m,
                  K == 'warn' and isnotnull(Wd) and Wd <= 730.0, nowW + 1d * Wd,
                  K == 'limit' and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 0.0, nowW - 1m,
                  K == 'limit' and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 730.0, nowW + 1d * DL,
                  datetime(null))
| where K == 'carry' or (isnotnull(T) and T <= nowW + 730d)
| extend Trend = K in ('warn', 'limit'), P95 = Item startswith 'Business transactions P95'
| extend What = case(
        K == 'warn', strcat('Payments P95 reach the ', WarnTxt, ' warning'),
        P95, strcat('Payments P95 reach the ', Lim, ' limit'),
        Item has 'pull token', 'Image pull token expires', Item has 'push token', 'Image push token lapses',
        Item startswith 'Password expires', 'Oracle password expires', Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows evaluation ends',
        Item has 'certificate', 'Ingress certificate expires', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'Oldest lab data starts to age out',
        Item == 'Node disk used', strcat(Resource, ' disk reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Memory used, busiest pod', strcat('Transfer pod memory reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Data into Log Analytics per day', strcat('Log Analytics reaches its ', Lim, ' daily cap'),
        Item has 'response', strcat(Resource, ' disk response reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Memory in use', strcat(Resource, ' memory reaches ', Lim),
        Item has 'Tablespace', strcat('Oracle tablespace reaches ', Lim),
        Item endswith ' used', strcat(Resource, ' ', replace_string(Item, ' used', ''), ' full (', Lim, ')'),
        Item has 'requests', strcat(Resource, ' ', tolower(Item), ' reach ', Lim),
        Item startswith 'Pods', strcat(Resource, ' reaches the ', Lim, ' limit'),

// Look-ahead month view (Grafana Canvas) on the board MiniBank - Look-ahead: one row of fields for the fixed spots of the panel.
// READ-ONLY: reads only the Look-ahead risk register MiniBankLookahead() (the same function as the radar, tiles and register table).
// The board setting 'Look ahead to' (variable ff: 0, 7, 14, 30 days or a date yyyy-mm-dd) moves the date; nothing else changes.
// Known dates stay exact; capacity and speed dates come from the same straight-line trends; guard: only dates within 2 years.
let dn = dynamic(['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']);
let mn = dynamic(['','Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']);
let nowW = now() + 7h;
let ffs = trim(@'\s+', tostring(${ff:singlequote}));
let ffn = todouble(ffs);
let ffd = todatetime(ffs);
let A0 = case(isnotnull(ffn), nowW + 1d * max_of(0.0, min_of(ffn, 730.0)), isnotnull(ffd), ffd + 12h, nowW);
let A = max_of(nowW, min_of(A0, nowW + 730d));
let FF = A > nowW + 1h;
let fdd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dayofmonth(t)), ' ', tostring(mn[getmonth(t)]), iff(getyear(t) != getyear(nowW), strcat(' ', tostring(getyear(t))), '')) };
let fd = (t: datetime) { strcat(tostring(dn[toint(dayofweek(t) / 1d)]), ' ', fdd(t)) };
let th = (n: long) { iff(n >= 1000, strcat(tostring(n / 1000), ',', substring(tostring(1000 + n % 1000), 1)), tostring(n)) };
let nf = (x: real) { iff(x >= 100.0, th(tolong(round(x, 0))), tostring(round(x, 1))) };
let reg = materialize(MiniBankLookahead()
| extend DueW = todatetime(extract(@'due ([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})', 1, Limit)),
         Wd = todouble(extract(@'warning is reached in ([0-9.]+) days', 1, Basis)),

         WarnTxt = replace_string(extract(@'warning ([0-9.]+ [a-zA-Z%]+)', 1, Limit), '.0 ', ' '),
         Lim = replace_regex(replace_regex(Limit, @'\.0 ', ' '), @' \(warning.*$', ''),
         DL = todouble(DaysLeft),
         NowV = todouble(extract(@'^(-?[0-9.]+)', 1, Now)));
let ev = reg

                      Item startswith 'Business transactions P95', dynamic(['warn', 'limit']),
                      Lens in ('Capacity', 'Service') and isnotnull(DL) and DL <= 730.0, dynamic(['limit']),
                      Lens == 'Posture' and Status in ('Act', 'Watch'), dynamic(['carry']),

        Item has 'response', strcat(Resource, ' disk response reaches ', Lim),
        Item == 'Memory in use', strcat(Resource, ' memory reaches ', Lim),
        Item has 'Tablespace', strcat('Oracle tablespace reaches ', Lim),
        Item endswith ' used', strcat(Resource, ' ', replace_string(Item, ' used', ''), ' full (', Lim, ')'),
        Item has 'requests', strcat(Resource, ' ', tolower(Item), ' reach ', Lim),
        Item startswith 'Pods', strcat(Resource, ' reaches the ', Lim, ' limit'),
        Item has 'budget', strcat(replace_string(Item, ' - error budget left', ''), ' error budget used up'),
        Item has 'backup', 'Full backup', Item has 'Windows update', 'Windows updates',
        substring(strcat(Resource, ': ', Item), 0, 40)),
    Short = case(
        K == 'warn', strcat('P95 ', WarnTxt, ' warning'), P95, strcat('P95 ', Lim, ' limit'),
        Item has 'pull token', 'Pull token expires', Item has 'push token', 'Push token lapses',
        Item startswith 'Password expires', 'Oracle password', Item has 'evaluation', 'Windows eval ends',
        Item has 'certificate', 'Ingress cert expires', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'Oldest data ages out',
        Item == 'Node disk used', strcat(Resource, ' disk ', Lim), Item == 'Memory used, busiest pod', 'Transfer pod memory',
        Item == 'Data into Log Analytics per day', 'LA daily cap', Item has 'response', strcat(Resource, ' disk resp.'),
        Item == 'Memory in use', strcat(Resource, ' memory'), Item has 'Tablespace', 'Oracle tablespace',
        Item endswith ' used', strcat(Resource, ' ', replace_string(Item, ' used', ''), ' full'),
        Item has 'requests', strcat(Resource, iff(Item has 'Memory', ' mem', ' CPU'), ' requests'),
        Item startswith 'Pods', strcat(Resource, ' pods'),
        Item has 'budget', strcat(replace_string(Item, ' - error budget left', ''), ' budget out'),
        K == 'carry', iff(Item has 'backup', 'Full backup', iff(Item has 'Windows update', 'Windows updates', Item)), substring(strcat(Resource, ' ', Item), 0, 20)),
    Imp = case(
        K == 'warn', 'payments slower than the warning level', P95, 'the 95 % under 1 s target is missed',
        Item has 'pull token', 'image pulls fail: new or restarted pods cannot start', Item has 'push token', 'no new image pushes (none planned)',
        Item startswith 'Password', 'the app can no longer log on to Oracle: payments fail', Item has 'evaluation', 'the VM shuts down every hour',
        Item has 'certificate', 'clients reject the MiniBank web address', Item startswith 'Oldest', 'trends and back-tests lose their first days',
